اصطخمن (form VIII)
# اِصْطَخَمْنَ (iṣṭaḵamna) /isˤ.tˤa.xam.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِصْطَخَمَ (iṣṭaḵama)
# اِصْطَخِمْنَ (iṣṭaḵimna) /isˤ.tˤa.xim.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِصْطَخَمَ (iṣṭaḵama)
